description: Fix P0-3: D6 integration test discovery. D6 reports 0 integration test suites but 6 integration test files exist under packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/. Detection logic checks `testDir.includes('integration')` but actual file discovery via listFiles('.') returns paths like 'packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/test-d3-d6.ts' which the code groups incorrectly. Fix path matching to correctly identify integration suites from discovered test files.
steps: 1. Read d6-tests-scanner.ts lines 52-89 (test directory grouping logic). Current code: `if (testDir.includes('integration')) { integration.push(...) }` but testDir is a file path from listFiles, not a directory.

2. Change grouping logic: iterate over test files (not testDirs). For each .test.ts or .spec.ts file discovered, check if its path contains '/__tests__/integration/' or '__tests__\\integration\\' (handle both forward and backslash). If yes, extract the directory path and add to integration suites. If path contains '/__tests__/unit/' or generic '__tests__/', add to unit suites. If path contains '/e2e/' or 'tests/e2e/', skip (handled separately).

3. Deduplicate integration/unit suite entries by path. Currently code says 'const existsInUnit = unit.some(suite => testDir.startsWith(suite.path))' but this logic is backwards. Fix: track suite directories as Set<string>, only add unique directories as TestSuite entries.
4. For integration suites, count test files in each directory. Update TestSuite.testCount with actual file count instead of 0.

5. Add finding validation: after discovery, if integration.length === 0 but test files with 'integration' in path were found, add warning finding 'Integration test files found but not grouped correctly'.

6. Update integration test discovery finding message to report actual count: 'Discovered X unit test suites, Y integration test suites, Z E2E test suites' should show integration >= 1 for this repository.

7. Update __tests__/unit/d6-tests-scanner.test.ts: add test case 'should discover integration tests from packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/' that mocks listFiles returning ['packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/test-d3-d6.ts', 'packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/test-full-m1-pipeline.test.ts'] and asserts result.data.integration.length >= 1.

8. Update __tests__/integration/test-d3-d6.ts assertion on line 113: change condition from `testsResult.data.unit.length > 0` to also assert `testsResult.data.integration.length >= 5` (at least 5 integration suites expected based on 6 integration test files).

9. Run test-d3-d6.ts integration test to verify actual repository discovery now finds integration suites. Expected: integration.length >= 5, actual files: discovery-integration.test.ts, test-d1-d2.ts, test-d3-d6.ts, test-determinism.ts, test-full-m1-pipeline.test.ts, test-snapshot-builder.ts.
acceptance_criteria: D6 scanner discovers at least 5 integration test suites when scanning packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/
Integration suite TestSuite entries have testCount > 0 reflecting actual file count
Unit test d6-tests-scanner.test.ts includes assertion for integration discovery
Integration test test-d3-d6.ts passes with assertion testsResult.data.integration.length >= 5
verification: Run pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test — d6-tests-scanner.test.ts passes including new integration test assertion
Run node packages/project-llm-discovery/__tests__/integration/test-d3-d6.ts — reports integration suites >= 5 and exits 0
